references.name: Chinese Seal Script
references.evidence: The initial frame features ancient Chinese characters rendered in classical Zhuan Shu (seal script) style.

references.name: Reaction-Diffusion
references.evidence: The evolution of the strokes into a labyrinthine maze pattern mimics the Turing reaction-diffusion chemical morphogenetic model.

result.one_line: Ancient Chinese seal script characters morph and dissolve into a complex, organic reaction-diffusion labyrinth.
